During the [[Separatist War]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military storage outpost [[Mannett Point]] was '''taken''' by the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. In the middle of the night, separatists destroyed the bridge connecting the small island to the larger island of [[Avilatan]], and then overran the Republic defenders and took complete control of Mannett Point by dawn.<ref name="MP" />
